description: A strip marker removes the ogham, narrow no-break and medium mathematical spaces
notes: The spec says strip markers remove spaces, "interpreted as per Unicode's definition", without saying which definition it means. The ogham space mark U+1680, narrow no-break space U+202F and medium mathematical space U+205F are space separators (category Zs) with the White_Space property, but not in Pattern_White_Space, the set Unicode recommends for syntax (UAX #31). Stripping them is hashicorp/hcl's reading: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go trims with Go's unicode.IsSpace, which follows the White_Space property.
